name: Board Game
instruction: Could you create a board game set for me? It should include a square game board with a grid pattern. Add some game pieces, such as small figurines or tokens, that can be moved around the board. Include a set of cards with different instructions or challenges written on them. Add a pair of dice for rolling to determine the movement of the game pieces. Make sure the game looks fun and engaging for players of all ages.

Shape accuracy: The shape is not specified in the instruction.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The game pieces are proportionate to the board.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The grid pattern on the board is clearly defined.
The game pieces can be placed on the grid without obstruction.
Object distance and contact: The game pieces can move freely across the grid.
The dice rolling mechanism allows for varied movement.
There are no gap between the game pieces and the board.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components of the game are included.
The design adheres closely to the provided instructions.
